components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink fill primary action; default height 36px.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: Onest, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.205 0 0) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.76676 0.00009 271.152); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Onest, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Onest, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default form control; h-9, border input token.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.76676 0.00009 271.152); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Onest, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Quiet sidebar row; active uses restrained primary weight.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Onest, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
This is an operational tool, not a brochure. The visual system behaves like a well-lit workbench: neutral surfaces, sharp type hierarchy, and status color only where the job demands attention. Density serves long sessions of list/edit/sync work; breathing room prevents fatigue without drifting into marketing whitespace.

The system rejects playful chrome, gradient-glass SaaS theater, and any decoration that competes with catalog data. Structure comes from type weight, whitespace, and consistent shadcn-vue (new-york / neutral) patterns — not from ornamental cards or glow.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained OKLCH neutrals; semantic color for status only
Flat-by-default elevation; borders and tonal layers over heavy shadows
shadcn-vue primitives only; no parallel custom control kits

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: Hue is reserved for status and irreversible actions. Never paint marketing gradients, brand purple, or decorative accent washes across operational chrome.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Filled primary occupies ≤10% of a given screen. If every control shouts primary, none of them do.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second display face for marketing polish inside the instance. Onest is the source of truth.

rules.name: The Tabular Digits Rule
rules.body: Prices, IDs, and quantities use tabular numerals so columns align.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Shadows appear only as light state affordances, never as decorative hierarchy.

rules.name: The Portal Stack Rule
rules.body: Overlays follow the z-index scale in style.css. Popovers above dialogs; toasts above popovers; blocking alerts at the ceiling.

dos: Do keep neutrals dominant; use semantic color only for status and irreversible actions.
Do reuse shadcn-vue patterns with the same spacing and visual weight across pages.
Do load Onest and keep the Cyrillic-safe fallback stack; avoid system-ui.
Do honor WCAG AA, visible focus, keyboard paths, and prefers-reduced-motion.
Do favor tables, forms, and dialogs that optimize for sustained catalog work.
donts: Don't apply playful, colorful, or marketing-heavy aesthetics to operational tooling.
Don't build decorative dashboards that prioritize wow over legibility.
Don't use gradient-and-glass SaaS landing-page styling inside the instance.
Don't introduce purple-on-white / purple-to-indigo themes, neon glow, or emoji chrome.
Don't use side-stripe borders as colored accents.
Don't invent a second component kit beside components/ui.
